correctness.rationale: For K_(a,b), independent simultaneous parent samples give cross-part covariance z=qz=0, within-part x=q[1+(b-1)y]/b, y=q[1+(a-1)x]/a with q=(1-epsilon)^2. The temporal Markov kernel alternates between uniform part supports and gives R_(2l)=c^(2l-2)y; sign symmetry determines the entire pair law. At epsilon=1/2, y=(a+4b-1)/(15ab+a+b-1). Setting y=1/(3n+1) yields (5a-4n-1)b=n(a-1), satisfied identically by a_j=1+j(n-1), b_j=jn/(5j-4), n=2*lcm_j(5j-4). This ensures integrality, both parts >=2 and strictly increasing largest part a_j, including k=2. No step infers unbounded k from finite checks.
residual_risks: Only stationary single-root two-time observations, not higher-order temporal paths; finite computations are corroboration.
